description.value: The study used fMRI to compare heavy and light drinkers' BOLD responses to alcohol-related, concern-related, positive, negative, and neutral pictures.

spans.text: The present article reports functional magnetic resonance imaging data showing that even this pattern of alcohol consumption is associated with maladaptive neural responses to alcohol and other stimuli.

description.value: A two-group observational study of heavy and light drinkers recruited from university and community populations.
